tgw-flow-logs.title: AWS Transit Gateway Flow Logs - Amazon VPC Transit Gateways

elb_target_endpoint.format: IP:port, colon-joined; a dash when no target received the request.

examples.note: dev-index event, no target reached (e.g. a fixed-response or redirect action)

values.authenticate: Validated the session and added user info to the request headers.
values.fixed-response: Issued a fixed response configured on the rule.
values.forward: Forwarded the request to a target.
values.redirect: Redirected the request to another URL.
values.waf: Forwarded the request to AWS WAF to decide whether to allow it.
values.waf-failed: Attempted to forward the request to AWS WAF, but that attempt failed.

elb_error_reason.format: Quoted; a dash unless an authenticate or Lambda-target action failed. AWS's table lists roughly 60 codes across authenticate, JWT-validation, weighted-target-group and Lambda-target failure families; only a representative spread is entered here, the rest are at the cite.

values.AuthInvalidCookie: The authentication cookie is not valid.
values.AuthMissingCodeParam: The authorization response is missing the code query parameter.
values.LambdaInvalidResponse: The response from the Lambda target is malformed or missing required fields.
values.LambdaAccessDenied: The load balancer did not have permission to invoke the Lambda function.
values.WAFConnectionError: The load balancer could not connect to AWS WAF.
values.AWSALBTGCookieInvalid: The weighted-target-group cookie is not valid.

s3_bucket_owner.format: 64-character lowercase hex, or an assumed-role ARN, or a dash for an unauthenticated request.

s3_request_time.format: [%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z], UTC, bracketed in the raw log.

values.RefreshHit: Found in cache but expired; the edge revalidated with the origin before serving it.
values.Miss: Not in cache; the edge forwarded the request to the origin.
values.LimitExceeded: Denied because a CloudFront quota was exceeded.
values.CapacityExceeded: The edge returned HTTP 503; it lacked capacity to serve the object.
values.Error: A client (4xx) or server (5xx) error, or the viewer disconnected before the full response was sent.
values.Redirect: The edge redirected the viewer from HTTP to HTTPS per the distribution's settings.
values.LambdaExecutionError: The associated Lambda@Edge function did not complete.

cf_fle_status.format: A dash when field-level encryption is not configured on the distribution.

values.Processed: The request body was successfully parsed and encrypted before being forwarded.
values.ForwardedByContentType: Forwarded unparsed: no content type was configured for field-level encryption.
values.ForwardedByQueryArgs: Forwarded unparsed: the request carried a query argument not in the field-level-encryption configuration.
values.ForwardedDueToNoProfile: Forwarded unparsed: no profile was specified in the configuration.
values.MalformedContentTypeClientError: Rejected (HTTP 400): the Content-Type header was invalid.
values.MalformedInputClientError: Rejected (HTTP 400): the request body was invalid.
values.MalformedQueryArgsClientError: Rejected (HTTP 400): a query argument was empty or invalid.
values.RejectedByContentType: Rejected (HTTP 400): no content type was specified in the configuration.
values.RejectedByQueryArgs: Rejected (HTTP 400): no query argument was specified in the configuration.
values.ServerError: The origin server returned an error.
values.FieldLengthLimitClientError: A field configured to be encrypted exceeded the maximum length.
values.FieldNumberLimitClientError: The request carried more fields than the configuration allows.
values.RequestLengthLimitClientError: The request body exceeded the maximum length for field-level encryption.

examples.note: dev-index event, field-level encryption not configured

cf_event_time.format: date: YYYY-MM-DD; time: HH:MM:SS; both UTC, two separate columns.

examples.note: dev-index event, date and time columns joined for readability

values.NODATA: No traffic to or from the resource during the aggregation interval.
values.SKIPDATA: Some records were skipped, from an internal capacity constraint or error.

tgw_protocol.format: IANA protocol number (for example 6 = TCP, 17 = UDP).

tgw_bytes.format: Integer, per the flow's aggregation interval; not cumulative across intervals.

tgw_packets.format: Integer, per the flow's aggregation interval; not cumulative across intervals.
